mapper.select: SELECT room_id AS room_id, MAX(chat_name) AS chat_name, MAX(first_customer_time) AS last_time, COUNT(*) AS rounds, SUM(CASE WHEN replied = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS replied_count, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN replied = 1 THEN response_seconds END), 0) AS avg_resp_seconds, SUM(CASE WHEN response_status IN ('timeout','serious_timeout') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS timeout_count, SUM(CASE WHEN replied = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unreplied_count FROM work_wx_response_metric WHERE deleted = 0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND first_customer_time >= #{since} GROUP BY room_id ORDER BY unreplied_count DESC, timeout_count DESC

SELECT first_reply_user AS username, MAX(first_reply_name) AS real_name, COUNT(*) AS reply_count, ROUND(AVG(response_seconds), 0) AS avg_resp_seconds, SUM(CASE WHEN response_status IN ('timeout','serious_timeout') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS timeout_count FROM work_wx_response_metric WHERE deleted = 0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND replied = 1 AND first_reply_user IS NOT NULL AND first_reply_time >= #{since} GROUP BY first_reply_user ORDER BY reply_count DESC
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.room_id) FROM work_wx_response_metric m LEFT JOIN work_wx_message c ON c.msg_id = m.first_customer_msg_id AND c.deleted = 0
